edges: Pegeen laments losing Christy, who she refers to as the only playboy of the western world.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Christy's father, Old Mahon, survives a second attack from Christy.
Christy apologizes to his father and embraces him to regain Pegeen's love and the respect of the town.
The townsfolk shun Christy's father as a liar and a coward.
